May 13, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Rnc Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Discovery Communications (DISCK) by 42.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rnc Capital Management Llc sold 53,925 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 73,597 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.56 million, down from 127,522 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rnc Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Discovery Communications for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $15.23B market cap company. The stock increased 1.20% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $22.84. About 4.94 million shares traded. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ:DISCK) has declined 27.22% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.77% the S&P500.
Gam Holding Ag decreased its stake in Mercadolibre Inc (MELI) by 60.34% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gam Holding Ag sold 7,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 11.87% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4,600 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.45M, down from 11,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gam Holding Ag who had been investing in Mercadolibre Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $13.65 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.41% or $7.62 during the last trading session, reaching $309.01. About 798,626 shares traded or 9.18% up from the average. MercadoLibre, Inc. (NASDAQ:MELI) has risen 66.47% since May 13, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 54.92% the S&P500.

The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co on Monday, February 5 with “Hold”. Bank of America maintained it with “Buy” rating and $45000 target in Wednesday, April 11 report. As per Friday, October 28, the company rating was reinitiated by Morgan Stanley. The stock of MercadoLibre, Inc. (NASDAQ:MELI) has “Buy” rating given on Friday, February 23 by Stifel Nicolaus. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Goldman Sachs given on Tuesday, August 9. As per Wednesday, December 20, the company rating was downgraded by Citigroup.
